title: Shifted binomial probability recurrence
statement: For natural numbers $m,c,j$ with $j\le c$, let $P(m,c,j)=\binom{2m+c}{m+j}/2^{2m+c}$. Then $P(m,c+1,j)=P(m,c,j)\,\frac{2m+c+1}{2(m+c+1-j)}$.
